TRAFFIC ADVISORY: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has started conducting road works at the following locations in Quezon City and will last until February 28:

🚧 Ayala Street (from Aurora Boulevard to Buendia): Rehabilitation and upgrading of damaged paved roads

🚧 Quezon Avenue (from Hi Top Supermarket to before BIR Road): Preventive maintenance

🚧 Aurora Boulevard, Eastbound (from G. Araneta/Cubao area to 20th Avenue, and from PSBA/C5 Katipunan Avenue to the Quezon City and Marikina boundary): Preventive maintenance

Plan trips accordingly and expect potential delays in these areas.
#MMDA #mmdaatyourservice #TrafficAdvisory
